import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen_case, make_passing
from probability import window_thresholds
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
rng = random.Random(31337)
c = gen_case(rng, 512, 256, 32, 16, span=1000000000)
for s in c['slots']: s[1]=200
c['bucket']=[400,200]
print('windows before', len(c['windows']))
